+"""
+Loads the bytes of an image named by a reference a user may have set
+(a cut's image_path, a style reference, a profile image, ...).
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request for such a reference (SSRF). Only two
+kinds are served:
+
+- ``data:`` URLs, decoded in place;
+- objects in our own storage, given as a relative key or as the full
+  ``STORAGE_HOST`` URL the API hands out, read through the storage client.
+
+Everything else (any other URL, whatever host it names) is refused.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import re
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+_SCHEME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\-]*:")
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage key `ref` names, or None if it is not in our storage."""
+    if not ref or not isinstance(ref, str):
+        return None
+
+    key = ref.strip()
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and key.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = key[len(host) + 1:].split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+
+    # Whatever is left must be a plain relative key: no scheme, no host, and
+    # no segment that could walk out of the bucket.
+    if not key or _SCHEME.match(key) or "\\" in key:
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 0x20 or ord(ch) == 0x7F for ch in key):
+        return None
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the image bytes for `ref`, or None if it is missing or refused."""
+    if not ref or not isinstance(ref, str):
+        return None
+
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        if not ref.startswith("data:image") or "," not in ref:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(ref.split(",", 1)[1])
+        except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
+            return None
+
+    key = storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        logger.warning("Refused to load an image from outside our storage", ref=ref[:100])
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+def make_episode(client, headers, images):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry of `images` (None = no image)."""
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": r.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    episode_id = r.json()["id"]
+    for order, image in enumerate(images, start=1):
+        body = {"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order}
+        if image is not None:
+            body["image_path"] = image
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=body)
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def export(client, headers, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=headers)
+
+
+def mixed_images(stored_image):
+    return [
+        stored_image,                                # 1 ok
+        None,                                        # 2 no image yet
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",  # 3 refused address
+        data_url(),                                  # 4 ok
+        "cuts/test/does-not-exist.png",              # 5 not in storage
+        "",                                          # 6 empty image
+    ]
+
+

+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, mixed_images(stored_image))

+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        assert sorted(zf.namelist()) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_04.png", "missing.txt"]

+/** Cut numbers an export left out, from its `X-Missing-Cuts` response header. */
+export function parseMissingCuts(header: unknown): string[] {
+  if (typeof header !== "string") return []
+  return header.split(",").map((n) => n.trim()).filter((n) => /^\d+$/.test(n))
+}
